name: readiness
description: Canonical readiness identity exchanged by the private /health/ready endpoint. Plane admission binds the exact field set and values below; unknown or missing fields fail closed.

rules.feature_profile: must equal the profile declared by the Plane dependency manifest
rules.feature_profile_digest: sha256 over the canonical profile document produced by scripts/profile_digest.py
rules.migration_position: exact applied position from the versioned migration chain
rules.ready: must be true only when the database, Redis, and migration state are healthy
